mapper.sql: id, name, type, provider, base_url AS "baseUrl", model_name AS "modelName", dimension, temperature, max_tokens AS "maxTokens", timeout_ms AS "timeoutMs", is_default AS "isDefault", enabled, COALESCE(extra_params, '{}'::jsonb)::text AS "extraParamsJson", created_at AS "createdAt"
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, is_default AS "isDefault" FROM llm_model WHERE enabled = true AND type = #{type} ORDER BY is_default DESC, name ASC, id ASC

SELECT type, base_url AS "baseUrl", model_name AS "modelName", dimension, temperature, max_tokens AS "maxTokens", timeout_ms AS "timeoutMs", enabled, COALESCE(extra_params, '{}'::jsonb)::text AS "extraParamsJson", api_key_cipher AS "apiKeyCipher" FROM llm_model WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO llm_model (name, type, provider, base_url, api_key_cipher, model_name, dimension, temperature, max_tokens, timeout_ms, is_default, enabled, extra_params) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKeyCipher}, #{modelName}, #{dimension}, #{temperature}, #{maxTokens}, #{timeoutMs}, #{isDefault}, #{enabled}, CAST(#{extraParamsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE llm_model SET name = #{name}, provider = #{provider}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, api_key_cipher = COALESCE(#{apiKeyCipher}, api_key_cipher), model_name = #{modelName}, dimension = #{dimension}, temperature = #{temperature}, max_tokens = #{maxTokens}, timeout_ms = #{timeoutMs}, is_default = #{isDefault}, enabled = #{enabled}, extra_params = CAST(#{extraParamsJson} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE llm_model SET is_default = false WHERE type = #{type} AND is_default = true AND id != #{excludeId}
UPDATE llm_model SET is_default = true WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = true
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE embedding_model_id = #{id} OR rerank_model_id = #{id}) AS "knowledgeBaseCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM chat_conversation WHERE chat_model_id = #{id}) AS "conversationCount"
SELECT id, status FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE embedding_model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
